A.label: CANONICAL_COPIED
A.single_dimension: Native SimulationContext.play, immediate float32 and float64 copies after fetch; baseline.

B.label: R3_REPRODUCTION
B.single_dimension: Retain R3 read/serialization sequence and add independent copied snapshots; same lifecycle, no wake.

C.label: POST_CALLBACK_VS_FETCH
C.single_dimension: Install PhysX post-step callback and compare callback snapshot with immediately-after-fetch snapshot.

D.label: BORROWED_VS_COPIED
D.single_dimension: Retain tensor backing buffers across next step, compare borrowed references to immutable copies; no writes.

E.label: PHYSX_TENSOR_VS_TRANSFORMS
E.single_dimension: Add raw tensor getter and physical link7/link8 observations to wrapper readings; same scene, no source mutation.

F.label: RENDER_REFRESH
F.single_dimension: Call documented SimulationContext.render after explicit fetch; log extra callbacks and reject unexpected physics advancement; other controls unchanged.
